564a1095cbb85f96.description: About the Role Acwa China is seeking an Electrical Technician to join their team. This full-time role involves executing various maintenance activities on plant equipment under the direction of an Electrical Supervisor or Engineer. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Job Summary The Electrical Technician will be responsible for performing preventive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance, as well as annual outage and overhauling work activities. All tasks must be carried out with strict adherence to safety protocols and maintenance procedures. Key Responsibilities Ensure all duties are performed safely, efficiently, and effectively, complying with NOMAC safety rules and regulations. Execute all plant maintenance activities in a timely and safe manner, following applicable maintenance procedures and work instructions. Document maintenance concerns and history for assigned equipment. Report spare parts and consumables requirements to the Electrical Supervisor/Engineer and monitor spare parts availability. Ensure proper isolations are conducted before commencing maintenance activities, in coordination with the Electrical Supervisor and local operator. Troubleshoot, diagnose problems, and perform maintenance on electrical equipment within jurisdiction. 56a490751b028ecf.description: About the Role SIHAMCO is seeking an experienced Maintenance Supervisor to oversee maintenance, facilities, and technical operations across a large hospitality, F&B, and entertainment venue. This full-time role involves managing a multidisciplinary maintenance team and ensuring all facilities, outdoor areas, landscaping, lighting installations, and infrastructure are maintained to high standards and remain fully operational. Key Responsibilities Oversee all general maintenance activities across buildings, restaurants, public areas, walkways, gardens, and operational facilities. Develop and implement preventative maintenance schedules and coordinate reactive maintenance. Manage and supervise a multidisciplinary maintenance team, including Lighting Operators, Gardeners, Plumbers, Painters, and General Maintenance Technicians. Monitor team performance, attendance, productivity, and quality of work, ensuring adherence to safety procedures and maintenance standards. Oversee the maintenance and functionality of decorative, landscape, façade, and general venue lighting. Supervise gardeners responsible for maintaining gardens, trees, plants, lawns, and landscaped areas, including irrigation systems. Oversee plumbing maintenance, including water supply, drainage, restrooms, and kitchen facilities. Coordinate painting, touch-ups, repairs, and general refurbishment requirements. Experience in hospitality, hotels, resorts, entertainment venues, theme parks, or large commercial developments is highly preferred. Good technical knowledge of lighting systems, plumbing, landscaping, painting, and general building maintenance. Experience developing preventative maintenance plans and managing daily maintenance schedules. Strong leadership, organisational, and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple maintenance requirements in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication and contractor management skills. Good understanding of health and safety procedures. Benefits SIHAMCO offers a competitive salary package aligned with market standards and experience. Benefits for non-citizens include a 1-year temporary visa and flights into the country, accommodation, and a transportation allowance. The company supports career development and internal promotions within a creative and collaborative work culture. Employees gain exposure to high-end hospitality and entertainment concepts, including premium events within The Groves, Riyadh Season, and work within a culturally diverse team.

56ae6fef876ccfa1.description: About AECOM AECOM is a global infrastructure consulting firm dedicated to delivering a better world through improved commutes, reliable power, clean water access, and transformative skylines. The company partners with clients to address complex challenges and build lasting legacies. With over 50,000 professionals worldwide, AECOM focuses on projects that create a positive and tangible impact. Role Overview AECOM is seeking an experienced Senior Resident Engineer (Project Director) to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves serving as the on-site technical leader and project director, overseeing all engineering and construction activities. The successful candidate will ensure compliance with project specifications, quality standards, and safety protocols, managing daily site operations and coordinating multidisciplinary teams to drive project success. Key Responsibilities Direct and oversee all on-site engineering and construction activities, ensuring adherence to project plans, specifications, and contractual requirements. Manage and supervise engineering teams, contractors, and subcontractors, fostering a collaborative and safety-focused work environment. Conduct regular site inspections and quality audits to verify compliance with engineering standards, building codes, and regulatory requirements. Analyze technical drawings, specifications, and project documentation to identify potential issues and implement corrective actions. Prepare and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including daily reports, progress updates, and technical records. Coordinate with project stakeholders, clients, and design teams to address concerns, resolve conflicts, and ensure alignment on project objectives. Monitor project timelines and budgets, identifying risks and implementing mitigation strategies to maintain schedule and cost performance. Ensure strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental protocols across all site operations. Conduct design reviews and provide technical recommendations to optimize construction methodologies and project efficiency. Manage change orders, variations, and claims while maintaining detailed documentation and communication with all parties. Utilize CAD, BIM, and project management software to track progress, analyze data, and generate performance reports. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Proven experience in overseeing engineering and construction activities as a Senior Resident Engineer or Project Director. Demonstrated ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with various stakeholders. Strong understanding of project specifications, quality standards, and safety protocols. AECOM is an Equal Opportunity Employer and maintains confidentiality of all applicant information according to EEO guidelines.

5699bf6ff89a0daa.description: About the Role SGS is seeking an experienced Laboratory Manager Geotechnical Lab to lead and manage geotechnical laboratory operations. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on ensuring technical excellence, quality compliance, and operational efficiency within the laboratory. Role Overview The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in advanced geotechnical testing, laboratory accreditation, and quality management systems, coupled with proven leadership capabilities. The role involves overseeing all daily laboratory activities and ensuring adherence to international standards. Key Responsibilities Independently manage and oversee all day-to-day geotechnical laboratory operations, ensuring efficiency, accuracy, and timely delivery of testing services. Lead, supervise, and manage laboratory engineers, technicians, and support personnel, ensuring technical competency and productivity. Oversee advanced geotechnical laboratory testing, particularly Triaxial, Consolidation, Direct Shear, and Permeability Tests, along with other soil classification and engineering tests. Ensure all testing activities comply with applicable ASTM, BS, AASHTO, and other relevant international standards. Develop, implement, and maintain the laboratory Quality Management System in accordance with ISO/IEC 17025 requirements. Lead laboratory accreditation processes, internal and external audits, assessments, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Ensure the technical validity, accuracy, and reliability of test results and laboratory reports. Manage laboratory equipment, including calibration, maintenance, verification, and procurement requirements. Establish and monitor laboratory operational procedures, performance indicators, resource utilization, and quality objectives. Maintain effective relationships with clients, consultants, project teams, and other stakeholders to ensure customer satisfaction and service quality. Manage laboratory budgets, operational costs, and resources effectively. Ensure compliance with laboratory health, safety, and environmental requirements. Required Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in geotechnical laboratory operations. Demonstrated expertise in advanced geotechnical testing methods. Experience with laboratory accreditation processes and quality management systems (ISO/IEC 17025). Proven leadership and management capabilities. Work Environment This role operates within a geotechnical laboratory setting, requiring adherence to strict quality, safety, and environmental standards. The position involves managing a team of engineers and technicians, fostering a productive and compliant work environment. Application Process Candidates interested in this opportunity are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

562c01b6eb64ab9c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة اول النائفات للمقاولات عن مشرف مزرعة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتنفيذ العمليات التشغيلية الزراعية في مزارع المحاصيل المختلطة ومزارع الحيوانات، مع التركيز على استنبات المحاصيل وزراعتها وحصادها، بالإضافة إلى تربية الحيوانات ومتابعة نموها. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على جميع مراحل إنتاج المحاصيل، بما في ذلك تحضير الحقول، واستنبات النباتات، ومتابعة نموها، وحصادها أو قطفها. متابعة نمو الحيوانات والإشراف على جميع مراحل الإنتاج المتعلقة بتربيتها، وأداء المهام ذات الصلة مثل الحلب أو الجز. ضمان الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة والصحة العامة المعتمدة. تشغيل المركبات والآليات والمعدات الزراعية المختلفة، والقيام بأعمال التنظيف والصيانة الأساسية لها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الإشراف الزراعي أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تخطيط وتنفيذ العمليات الزراعية بكفاءة. معرفة جيدة بمراحل زراعة المحاصيل وتربية الحيوانات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة المعدات الزراعية الأساسية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة زراعية تتطلب العمل الميداني والإشراف المباشر على العمليات اليومية في المزرعة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في مؤسسة اول النائفات للمقاولات.

564ab5d2e77cfa12.job_title: Admin Coordinator Admin And Government Relations

566be8a42dddc0a9.description: About the Role ADES Holding Company is seeking a Day Tool Pusher to supervise and control all drilling operations activities during the day shift. This full-time role, based in Al Khobar, requires ensuring the successful completion of well and drilling activities while prioritizing the safety of personnel, the environment, and equipment to maximize operational efficiency. The Day Tool Pusher will work in close liaison with the OIM. Key Responsibilities Ensure the safety of personnel, equipment, and operational efficiency on the drill floor and associated areas. Plan and schedule all drilling and associated activities, directing personnel towards optimum job performance. Ensure planned maintenance and repair of drilling equipment (draw works, mud pumps, top drive, rotary table, BOP) are completed and documented. Carry out duties related to preparing the rig for towing, ensuring equipment is secured prior to rig moves. Promote and maintain effective working relationships with other departments, third-party personnel, and Client representatives. Maintain proper logs and records, submitting required reports such as daily drilling reports and equipment status reports. The ability to work up to 12 hours per day during the assigned shift is essential.

56e9f15a9709605c.job_title: Customer Support Engineer Solutions for Enterprise Imaging
56e9f15a9709605c.description: About the Role GE HealthCare is seeking a Customer Support Engineer for Enterprise Imaging Solutions to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting, troubleshooting, and maintaining enterprise imaging solutions, including RIS, PACS, VNA, Cardiology, integrations, and associated IT infrastructure. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and a strong background in Healthcare IT. Role Overview The Customer Support Engineer will serve as a customer-facing Healthcare IT professional, responsible for the installation, commissioning, and ongoing support of GE Digital solutions. This role focuses on ensuring sustained customer success through technical support, training, and critical incident management. The engineer will execute standard operational and technical tasks, with the ability to adjust work sequences based on changing situations, impacting the quality of their own work and that of the team. Key Responsibilities Research and troubleshoot issues across GE Digital solutions, including configuration, user interface, network connectivity, Cloud and on-premise interoperability, data management, analytics, and hardware infrastructure. Lead and manage all aspects of installation, configuration, and commissioning for healthcare IT systems such as RIS, PACS (Radiology & Cardiology), Archiving, VNA, and third-party applications. Provide onsite and remote technical support to customers, ensuring high system availability and quality. Perform root cause analysis for issues and coordinate with internal and global support teams. Act as the primary technical point of contact for customer incidents and service requests. Conduct regular system health checks to proactively identify and mitigate risks. Fulfill Resident Engineer assignments onsite as required by contractual obligations and customer expectations. Support project activities, including pre-sales and post-sales tasks such as surveys, go-lives, upgrades, and migrations. Maintain documentation, reporting, and knowledge sharing in accordance with company standards. Drive continuous improvement initiatives for support processes and customer experience. Develop strong customer relationships and serve as the interface between the customer and GE HealthCare. Required Qualifications Ability to operate independently in customer-facing and resident engineer roles. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Solid foundation in key IT practices and principles. Excellent communication and customer-facing skills. Willingness to travel 50%+ based on business needs. Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to document, plan, support, and execute programs. Technical Expertise The role requires hands-on Healthcare IT expertise, including strong knowledge of DICOM/HL7, databases, virtualization, and infrastructure technologies. Candidates should possess a basic understanding of key business drivers and how their team's work integrates with other teams to contribute to the overall area. The ability to resolve issues within established procedures and consult senior team members for complex situations is essential. 567f8da6c1437d49.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth. Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value. Why This Role Matters At Lucidya, closing a deal is the beginning of the work - not the end of it. Enterprise clients come with complex requirements, multiple stakeholders, and zero tolerance for delivery that doesn't match what was promised. This role sits at the centre of that delivery. You will be the operational backbone that keeps projects on track, stakeholders aligned, and risks visible before they become problems. You will work across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal - not as a coordinator, but as the person who holds the whole picture and makes sure every part of the business is moving in the same direction. If you are the kind of person who gets uncomfortable when things are vague, who builds structure because it actually helps, and who takes personal ownership of whether a project lands well - this role is for you. What You Will Do Own delivery from pre-RFP to go-live. Lead pre-RFP alignment sessions to validate scope, timeline, resource availability, and budget assumptions before any commitment is made. Establish and enforce a handover framework from RFP to delivery - with clear ownership and traceability at every stage of the project lifecycle. Ensure every project proposal goes through cross-functional validation (Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Legal, Finance) before it goes out the door. Review vendor and subcontractor arrangements for procurement compliance and operational readiness. Run governance like it matters - because it does. Design and maintain project governance frameworks that define accountability, escalation paths, and decision-making checkpoints. Keep a live project and risk register covering progress, dependencies, financial exposure, and compliance risks. Maintain executive dashboards and PMO reports that give leadership real visibility - not a sanitised summary. Enforce stage gates and approval processes before any contractual, financial, or delivery commitment is made. Run post-implementation reviews that actually produce lessons, not just documentation. Keep every part of the business aligned. Serve as the central coordination point across Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Finance, Legal, and Delivery. Lead project initiation, steering, and review meetings - and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates. Maintain consistent communication with internal and external stakeholders through dashboards, executive summaries, and progress reports that people actually read. Facilitate procurement and vendor coordination, ensuring external partners meet internal standards and regulatory requirements. Manage third-party and vendor risk. Oversee vendor and third-party onboarding governance - tools, processors, and contractors must meet data protection and regulatory standards before they touch a project. Maintain a Third-Party Risk Register tracking compliance obligations, privacy safeguards, and mitigation activities. Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, and Data Privacy on risk assessments, incident responses, and breach reporting related to external partners. Bring the same rigour to internal programmes. Extend the PM framework beyond client projects to internal strategic initiatives - process transformation, system rollouts, product programmes. Track progress against annual strategic objectives and KPIs, and report it clearly to leadership. Develop and maintain standardised PM tools, templates, and procedures that the wider team can actually use. You are responsible for outcomes: projects that land on time, within budget, and without surprises. Who You Are You have 5+ years in project or programme management, preferably in SaaS or enterprise technology. You have managed complex, multi-workstream projects and you know what good governance looks like in practice. You are comfortable holding multiple complex projects simultaneously without dropping the thread on any of them. You think in terms of risk before others see it. You flag early, escalate when you should, and never let a problem fester because it was uncomfortable to raise. You have real financial acumen - cost modelling, budget tracking, and ROI analysis are not tasks you hand off. You can influence without authority.
